prompt: The client's costs are rising and it wants to know where to look first. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Labor is the largest cost, at $54M in 2025
options.feedback: True, but labor rose only 4 (50 to 54). The question is where costs are rising, and that is materials.

options.text: Labor and materials grew by similar amounts
options.feedback: Labor grew 4 (50 to 54); materials grew 18 (30 to 48).

options.text: Supplier price rises pushed materials costs up
options.feedback: The chart shows materials rising, not why. That may be true, but nothing here supports it.

options.text: Most of the cost rise comes from materials
options.feedback: Right. Total cost rose 22 (100 to 122); materials account for 18 of it (30 to 48).

explanation: Total cost rose 22 (100 to 122); materials account for 18 of it (30 to 48).

extras.proof: Total cost rose 22 (100 to 122); materials account for 18 of it (30 to 48).
